problem: Calculate the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $14{x}^{2}-3{y}^{2}=50$ intersects the line $y=2x.$
worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=2x,$ we first replace $y$ with $2x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}14{x}^{2}-3{y}^{2} & =50 \\ 14{x}^{2}-3(2x)^{2} & =50 \\ 14{x}^{2}-12{x}^{2} & =50 \\ 2{x}^{2} & =50 \\ {x}^{2} & =25 \\ x & =\pm 5\end{aligned}
$$
